title: Block execution-ready negative when another ASIN may benefit
scenario: A search term has high spend and zero orders for the focal ASIN, but the ad group contains two advertised ASINs and purchased-ASIN attribution is incomplete.

forbidden_behaviors: Recommend an execution-ready negative solely because the focal view shows zero orders.
Claim the term is proven irrelevant without purchased-ASIN or equivalent scope evidence.
required_observations: The ad group contains multiple advertised ASINs.
Purchased-ASIN or halo evidence is missing.
The zero-order observation is insufficient to prove account-level irrelevance.

rubric.requirement: Recognize Mixed-ASIN attribution risk before proposing a negative.
Downgrade the recommendation to blocked, directional, or manual review.
Keep the result in Suggest mode.
